$comment: The permission profile the JUDGE is launched with (role forseti; RULES/08, appended 2026-11-21 at the Allfather's word: every PR is reviewed by the judge, and an approval merges at once). It is the worker profile (claude-worker.settings.json) with ONE road opened: the merge door. Measured 2026-11-21: three judges approved PRs and were refused at the merge, because every Claude seat carried the worker profile, which denies `gh pr merge`; the arm holder merged by hand. The door is bin/forge/judge-merge.sh (act <review-id>: reads the verdict, then calls) bin/agents/pr-seal.sh seal <n> --repo <owner/repo> --head <approved-sha>, which re-checks at that instant — every check SUCCESS and none pending, mergeable, not a draft, no hold label, no state/.seal-hold, the head is the approved head, gh acts as the registry's owner — then merges with bin/forge/merge-method.sh's method and a written body, and carves one Rune. Raw `gh pr merge`, the raw merge API, `git merge` and every push to main stay DENIED, so the door's checks cannot be skipped. Deny rules win over allow rules; the explicit allow entries name the one road. Keep the env and the rest of the lists in step with the worker profile (tests/test_claude_seat_roles.sh holds it).
